adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Newborn nonshivering thermogenesis is mediated by UCP1 in brown-fat mitochondria, which dissipates the proton gradient as heat instead of coupling proton reentry to ATP generation.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: Electron-transport inhibition also reduces ATP but does not physiologically generate adaptive heat. UCP1 allows proton leak while respiration continues, making uncoupling the unique mechanism.
